Huafeng Technology.why: Makes high-speed backplane connectors and high-speed cable modules for AI servers and data centers (112G in volume production, 224G in mass production since June 2026), so AI-server build-out drives its main growth.
Huafeng Technology.evidence: Huafeng Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026): AI-server and data-center demand drove revenue growth, with core products such as high-speed cable modules raising their penetration in leading server equipment; 112G products in stable volume production and delivery, entering the supply chain of mainstream computing equipment.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed backplane cable modules and backplane connectors, CPU sockets for AI servers

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, board secretary): 224G high-speed cable modules entered mass production in June 2026, with high capacity utilization while yield and efficiency are still ramping; the company is expanding capacity for 2027, with the actual capacity depending on staffing, equipment commissioning, yield improvement and customer project progress. Asked whether 224G raises per-set value over 112G, management said yes: the two suit racks with different performance and design requirements and their per-set value differs to some degree. The high-speed cable module lines are designed in-house and custom-built by equipment suppliers; demand is strong, orders are sufficient and capacity construction is proceeding to meet customer deliveries.
Management (IR record): CPU Socket and FPC Socket products have achieved batch delivery.
Management (IR record): main customers of the new-energy-vehicle business include automakers SAIC-GM-Wuling, BYD, Changan and FAW Bestune, plus leading tier-1 suppliers including EVE Energy.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed copper backplane cable modules and connectors; NPO sockets and NPO optical modules in development

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the NPO Socket, co-developed with a leading chip customer and already verified, is expected to reach small-scale mass production in Q4 2026 and batch delivery in 2027 in line with the major customer's demand schedule.
